          },

            "lineNumber": 371
          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 373
          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "        # 非同期実行",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "        threading.Thread(target=self._execute_task_async, args=(task_description,), daemon=True).start()",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },

            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "    def _execute_task_async(self, task_description):",

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
